## INCIDENT RESPONSE REPORT

**Incident Date:** 2024-11-26  
**Analysis Date:** 2024-11-26  
**Classification:** NetSupport Manager RAT Infection with Lateral Movement Attempt

---

### INFECTED/VICTIM HOST

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| **IPv4 Address** | 10.11.26.183 |
| **MAC Address** | d0:57:7b:ce:fc:8b |
| **Windows Hostname** | DESKTOP-B8TQK49 |
| **Logged-in User Account** | oboomwald |
| **Domain/Workgroup** | NEMOTODES |

---

### MALWARE IDENTIFICATION

**Malware Family:** NetSupport Manager RAT  
**Attribution Type:** Signature-confirmed (Suricata ET-Pro alerts)

Evidence for identification:
- HTTP User-Agent: "NetSupport Manager/1.3"
- Multiple Suricata alerts confirming NetSupport RAT activity (SID-2028500)
- Beaconing pattern consistent with NetSupport Manager C2 communication
- GeoIP lookup requests to geo.netsupportsoftware.com (legitimate NetSupport service abused by malware)

---

### INDICATORS OF COMPROMISE (IOCs)

#### Command-and-Control Endpoints

| IP Address | Port | Protocol | Purpose | Evidence |
|------------|------|----------|---------|----------|
| 194.180.191.64 | 443 | HTTP/TLS | Primary C2 Server | POST requests to `/fakeurl.htm`, beacon interval ~60 seconds |
| 193.42.38.139 | 443 | TLS | Secondary C2 Server | C2 domain modandcrackedapk.com, large transfer volume (5.7 MB) |
| 104.26.1.231 | 80 | HTTP | GeoIP Lookup Service | Requests to geo.netsupportsoftware.com for geolocation |

#### Malicious Domains

| Domain | Resolution | First Seen | Last Seen | Purpose |
|--------|-----------|-----------|----------|---------|
| modandcrackedapk.com | 193.42.38.139 | 2024-11-26 08:50:14 UTC | 2024-11-26 08:50:40 UTC | C2 Domain (ZPHP flagged) |

#### Malicious URLs

| URL | Method | Beacon Interval | Data Volume |
|-----|--------|-----------------|-------------|
| http://194.180.191.64/fakeurl.htm | POST | ~60 seconds | 22-250 bytes per request |

#### Beaconing Pattern

- **Start Time:** 2024-11-26 08:50:45 UTC
- **End Time:** 2024-11-26 09:43:29 UTC (captured duration: ~53 minutes)
- **Interval:** 60.2 seconds ± 6.8 seconds (11.3% jitter)
- **Total Beacon Requests Captured:** 56
- **Payload Sizes:** 22-250 bytes (initial handshake), 36 bytes (steady-state beacons)

#### File Indicators

No executable files or payloads with hash values detected in the captured traffic. File transfers occurred via encrypted TLS connections to secondary C2 (193.42.38.139).

---

### LATERAL MOVEMENT ACTIVITY

The victim host attempted lateral movement to NEMOTODES-DC (domain controller):

| Activity | Target | Port | Protocol | Alert |
|----------|--------|------|----------|-------|
| SMB IPC$ Access | NEMOTODES-DC.nemotodes.health | 445 | SMB2 | "SMB IPC$ unicode share access" |
| Shared Files Access | NEMOTODES-DC | 445 | SMB2 | Tree Connect to "\\NEMOTODES-DC\Shared_Files" |
| EFS Remote Protocol | NEMOTODES-DC | 445 | DCERPC/EfsRpc | "EfsRpcOpenFileRaw" exploitation attempt |
| SMB NTMLSSP Auth | NEMOTODES-DC | 139 | NETBIOS | "SMB Session Setup NTMLSSP unicode asn1 overflow" |

---

### ATTACK TIMELINE

| Time (UTC) | Event |
|-----------|-------|
| 08:49:38 | System boot and network initialization |
| 08:49:40 | NetBIOS queries for DESKTOP-B8TQK49 hostname resolution |
| 08:49:41 | Kerberos AS-REQ to NEMOTODES KDC (10.11.26.3) |
| 08:49:55 | EFS Remote Protocol connection to NEMOTODES-DC (attempt to access encrypted files) |
| 08:50:10 | SMB exploit attempts against NEMOTODES-DC (port 139) |
| 08:50:14 | DNS queries for modandcrackedapk.com (ZPHP malicious domain) |
| 08:50:40 | TLS connection to 193.42.38.139 (modandcrackedapk.com C2) |
| 08:50:45 | Initial HTTP POST beacon to 194.180.191.64/fakeurl.htm (C2 check-in) |
| 08:51:46 onward | Consistent 60-second beacon intervals to primary C2 |

---

### NETWORK CONNECTIONS SUMMARY

- **Total Packets:** 26,922
- **Total Data Transfer:** 20.8 MB
- **Capture Duration:** ~1 hour
- **Infected Host Outbound Streams:** 100+
- **Lateral Movement Targets:** 1 (NEMOTODES-DC)
- **Identified C2 Servers:** 3
- **Identified Malicious Domains:** 1

---

### ASSESSMENT

The workstation is **actively compromised** with NetSupport Manager RAT providing attackers remote access and control. The malware has established persistent C2 communication via HTTP POST beaconing with a ~60-second check-in interval. Evidence of lateral movement exploitation against the domain controller indicates potential active directory compromise attempts. Immediate containment and forensic analysis of the endpoint is required.
